item.title: memvid
item.description:
The Problem
AI agents lack persistent, portable memory. Current solutions require vector databases, RAG pipelines, or cloud infrastructure—adding latency, complexity, and vendor lock-in. There is no standard way to give an agent a memory file it can carry between sessions, environments, or model providers.
What This Does

item.description:
The Problem Ever tried taking notes during a meeting while also trying to engage? It's a mess. item.title: qr data transfer
item.description:
The Problem
Transferring files between devices without a network connection, cable, or cloud intermediary remains impractical for most users. Existing QR-based approaches fail on files larger than a few kilobytes because static QR codes have severe capacity limits.
What This Does
